title: Copilot read/creative assistance
scope_items: Database Migration 00016: Created copilot_sessions table with composite workspace tenant foreign keys, PostgreSQL row-level security enabled and forced, narrow grants, indexes, and session state tracking.

Acceptance Target 1 (Contributor cannot delete product): Strict RBAC enforcement refusing product deletion commands when issued by Contributor or non-admin roles (refusal message: 'Bạn không có quyền xóa sản phẩm. Cần Admin+ role (product:delete).'), leaving workspace resources completely unaltered.

Acceptance Target 2 (Read query cannot expose finance): Read queries executed by callers lacking financial analytics/read permissions ('copilot:use_analytics', 'finance:read') redact or refuse financial data (refusal message: 'Bạn không có quyền truy cập dữ liệu tài chính của workspace.'), preventing exposure of workspace revenue and margins.

Acceptance Target 3 (Generated script needs quote confirmation): Creative script generation strictly enforces credit quote preview (5 credits via ai_credit_quotes) and requires user confirmation before initiating drafting in Script Lab (M06) and debiting credits.

Protobuf & Connect-Go Codegen: Defined creativanta.copilot.v1 CopilotService with 28 canonical RPCs mapped to rpc_permission_bindings.csv, achieving zero drift across Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript, and Dart targets.
Web Frontend (SvelteKit 5): Implemented CopilotSidebar (W008), CopilotMessageBubble, QuotePreviewCard, and client evaluation engine with reactive credit balance tracking and denial handling.
Mobile Frontend (Flutter): Implemented CopilotView (M060) with role switching, refusal badge display, credit quote preview card, and quick action chips passing all widget and unit test suites.
external_gates: PostgreSQL 17.10 Live Database Container (CI pipeline validates live PostgreSQL migration, RLS enforcement, and AppUser isolation)
Clerk Production Identity / Real OAuth (unconfigured local environments fail-closed safely without live keys)
AI Provider Production Endpoint / LLM Inference (guarded by ai_credit_quotes preflight hold mechanism)
